lean.statement:
{f : E → ℝ} {κ h : ℝ} {J : ℕ}
    (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hH : ∀ z v, (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hJ : 2 ≤ J) (hh : 0 < h) :
    let t := fun i : Fin J => h/2*(1-Real.cos ((i : ℝ)/(J-1 : ℝ)*Real.pi))
    let ell := fun j : Fin J => Lagrange.basis Finset.univ t j
    let Λ := sSup ((fun s : ℝ => ∑ j : Fin J, |(ell j).eval s|) '' Icc 0 h)
    let ω := fun i j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..t i, (t i-s)*(ell j).eval s
    let b := fun j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..h, (ell j).eval s
    let c := fun j : Fin J => ∫ s in 0..h, (h-s)*(ell j).eval s
    h * Λ ≤ 1/(65536*κ) →
    let a := Real.exp (-h / 2)
    let sigma := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-h))
    let P0 := fun (z ζ : E × E) => a • z.2 + sigma • ζ.1
    let Y0 := fun (z ζ : E × E) j => z.1 + t j • P0 z ζ
    let Y1 := fun (z ζ : E × E) i => Y0 z ζ i - ∑ j, ω i j • gradient f (Y0 z ζ j)
    let Φ := fun w : (E × E) × (E × E) =>
      (w.1.1 + h • P0 w.1 w.2 - ∑ j, c j • gradient f (Y1 w.1 w.2 j),
        a • (P0 w.1 w.2 - ∑ j, b j • gradient f (Y1 w.1 w.2 j)) + sigma • w.2.2)
    let Γ := (stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian E)
    ∃ K : Kernel (E × E) (E × E), IsMarkovKernel K ∧
      (∀ z, K z = Γ.map (fun ζ => Φ (z,ζ))) ∧
      ∀ (μ ν : Measure (E × E)), IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
        K ∘ₘ μ = (μ.prod Γ).map Φ ∧ K ∘ₘ ν = (ν.prod Γ).map Φ ∧
        phaseWassersteinSq κ (K ∘ₘ μ) (K ∘ₘ ν) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1-h/(65536*κ))^2) * phaseWassersteinSq κ μ ν
approved_definition_context: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space. ContDiff R 2 f means globally C2; fderiv R (fderiv R f) is its actual second derivative, and gradient f is the Riesz representative of its derivative.

Fin J indexes0 through J-1; Lagrange.basis gives cardinal polynomials at the displayed nodes, eval is polynomial evaluation, sSup is the real supremum. Interval integrals are ordinary Lebesgue Bochner integrals.

stdGaussian E is the standard centered identity-covariance Gaussian measure. Gamma is the independent product of two such laws, used for the two refreshes of the displayed actual Phi. Kernel means a measurable probability-transition measure family; IsMarkovKernel means probability at every state. K composed with mu is measure/kernel composition.

phaseQuadraticForm kappa (x,p)=((1/(2*kappa))+(1/2))*norm(x)^2+inner R x p+norm(p)^2; phaseCost kappa (z,zprime)=ENNReal.ofReal(phaseQuadraticForm kappa (z-zprime)). phaseWassersteinSq kappa mu nu is the raw infimum of the lintegral of that cost over all measures gamma with gamma.fst=mu and gamma.snd=nu. No optimizer or finite moment convention is imposed. Measure.prod is independent product and Measure.map is pushforward.
